program_amendments.change: Replace overhead cable triceps extensions with cable pushdowns, starting at 50 lb, due to athlete-reported tendon stress. Ongoing replacement; no automatic overhead restoration.
Hold direct biceps loads/reps/set counts at latest performed doses until elbow symptoms resolve/review. Defer unintroduced reverse curls; keep wrist-curl review separate.

Adopt pace-first running: one recovered session with all-rep pace headroom can earn 5–15 s/mi; comfortable effort earns 5, otherwise two comparable hits earn 5. Hold minutes on pace changes. Remove calendar speed locks; only relevant recovery/tolerance restrictions limit running.
